paragraphs: The GLA180 was part of the first-generation GLA-Class range (X156), produced from 2013 to 2020. It uses the M270 - a 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol engine shared with the A-Class and B-Class of the same era. The M270 is a turbocharged direct-injection unit that formed the backbone of Mercedes' compact petrol range throughout the 2010s. The GLA180 was discontinued when the second-generation H247 GLA-Class arrived from 2020, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every GLA180 on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the GLA180 from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.
